title: Jensen Huang was a busted flush at Nvidia – he had to go | Nils Pratley
summary: CEO was viewed as ‘irreplaceable’, but recklessness of affair with a woman regarded by US officials as a Chinese spy made him a political liability Half the tech world made up its mind before the facts could be assessed properly. Jensen Huang was “irreplaceable”, said the chorus at the start of this week. Nvidia would melt without the co-founder’s brilliance, apparently. The chipmaker’s board had to find a way to save its genius for the sake of corporate America and the entire AI universe. It was always nonsense because, after the passage of only a few days since his confession of infidelity, Huang looked less like a towering corporate titan and more like a political liability. Continue reading...
title_en: Jensen Huang's Departure from Nvidia: A Political Liability
title_zh: 黄仁勋离开英伟达：政治负担
summary_en: Jensen Huang's affair with a woman seen by US officials as a Chinese spy made him a political liability, forcing his exit from Nvidia despite being viewed as 'irreplaceable'.
summary_zh: 黄仁勋因与一名被美国官员视为中国间谍的女性有染而成为政治负担，尽管曾被视为“不可替代”，仍被迫离开英伟达。

title: Jensen Huang built an AI kingdom. Now he’s gone, will Nvidia’s ramparts be breached?
summary: CEO’s affair and resignation has brought company’s murky corporate contracts and supply chains into sharp focus Can the AI economy survive without its “central bank”? What does Jensen Huang’s fall mean for the world’s second-most valuable company, and what might a tremor in its fortunes mean for the world? Nvidia’s sky-high valuation is based on the fact that it designs and sells the advanced AI chips, called graphics processing units (GPUs), that underpin the AI economy. Without these, AI models such as ChatGPT and Claude could not be trained and would not run. Continue reading...
title_en: Jensen Huang exits Nvidia, raising questions over AI chip dominance
title_zh: 黄仁勋离开英伟达，AI芯片霸主地位面临考验
summary_en: Jensen Huang's resignation after an affair exposes Nvidia's opaque contracts and supply chains, raising doubts about whether the AI economy can survive without its central figure and whether rivals can breach Nvidia's GPU dominance.
summary_zh: 黄仁勋因婚外情辞职，令英伟达不透明的合同与供应链备受关注，外界质疑失去核心人物的AI经济能否存续，以及竞争对手能否撼动其GPU霸主地位。
